name: forkcast-services
description: Microservices backend for Forkcast food delivery platform

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:menu" "npm run dev:order" "npm run dev:search" "npm run dev:notification" "npm run dev:upload"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd api-gateway && npm install && cd ../menu-service && npm install && cd ../order-service && npm install && cd ../search-service && npm install && cd ../notification-service && npm install && cd ../upload-service && npm install
scripts.build:all: npm run prisma:generate && npm run build --workspace=./shared && npm run build --workspace=./api-gateway && npm run build --workspace=./menu-service && npm run build --workspace=./order-service && npm run build --workspace=./search-service && npm run build --workspace=./notification-service && npm run build --workspace=./upload-service
